correctness.rationale: C PASS: Four-part partitions biject with (a,u,v,w); expanded e2 formula is exact. Differentiated geometric products give the displayed reduced rational generating function, verified symbolically. Four integer resultants are 864, 32, 144, 36; thus denominator and numerator are coprime mod p>=5. Divisibility by 1-q^T and characteristic-p multiplicities prove least periods 300 for p=5 and 12p for p>=7; degree of quotient gives pure periodicity from n=0. Exact standalone symbolic and independent finite checks passed.

originality.rationale: O PASS in inspected evidence: The closest 2024 Ballantine–Beck–Merca paper explicitly calls the recurrence and least-period table conjectural, proves only moduli 2,3,4; its conjecture for primes p>=5 is not a theorem. Kwong and Nijenhuis–Wilf treat unweighted p4 counts. The later Elementary symmetric partitions studies different image-statistics. Five literal thematic database searches found no equivalent claim; search absence is not proof of uniqueness. Residual risk: possible unindexed, unpublished, or later work.
